# High Rise Interiors

> Bespoke Interior Architecture & Turnkey Luxury Execution in Hyderabad, India.
> Website: https://highriseinteriors.in/
> Contact: +91 7569826055 | info@highriseinteriors.com
> Studio: Hyderabad, Telangana, India

## About High Rise Interiors
High Rise Interiors (HRI) is a premier residential interior architecture and turnkey fit-out firm based in Hyderabad. With 6+ years of mastery, 6 spatial architects & project engineers, and a workforce of 80+ master craftsmen, HRI elevates luxury residences ranging from 2,500 to 10,000+ sq. ft.

## Core Specializations
- **Luxury Villa Interiors**: Turnkey interior architecture for private estates, duplexes, and triplexes across Jubilee Hills, Banjara Hills, Gandipet, and Kokapet. Expertise in double-height living spaces, home automation, acoustic home theaters, and imported Italian marble finishes.
- **Gated Community Interiors**: End-to-end turnkey fit-outs for 3BHK, 4BHK, and penthouses in Hyderabad's premier gated enclaves, including Rajapushpa (The Crown, Atria, Provincia), My Home (Bhooja, Grava, Tarkshya), Aparna (One, Zenon, Sarovar), Jayabheri, DSR, Honer, and ASBL. Strict compliance with society NOC guidelines and a guaranteed 45 to 60-day move-in handover.
- **Bespoke Modular Kitchens & Walk-in Wardrobes**: German Blum & Hettich hardware, anti-fingerprint acrylics, lacquered glass, sensor LED illumination, and customized island counters.
- **Curated Furniture & Lighting Collections**: Signature collections including Algerone sofas, Babel chandeliers, Waterfall suspensions, and ergonomic luxury dining suites.
